title: Repeated reads and copies of a small multipart file
summary: Two reads and a filesystem copy now returned all six in-memory upload bytes. Interleaved readers preserved independent positions at both storage thresholds.

change.description: Servlet multipart file parts retained in memory now create a fresh input stream for every read or transfer.

notes: The destination started longer than the upload. Its bytes and the first reader's remaining suffix were observed after transfer.
